full_judgment:
Khondker Musa Khaled J: This death reference, under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, has been made by Mr AR Masud, learned Sessions Judge of Druta Bichar Tribunal No. 4 Dhaka, seeking confirmation of death sentence imposed upon the absconding condemned accused (1) Kajal Ahmed Jalali under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code by his judgment and order dated 17-3-2004 passed in Druta Bichar Tribunal Case No. 38 of 2003, which arose out of Motijheel PS Case No. 26(7) 2001, corresponding to GR Case No.237 of 2001. 

 4. Prosecution case may, in short, be stated, as follows: 

 Deceased Shahjahan Howlader Shujan, aged about 33 years, of village Rupashdi, Banchharampur, district Brahmanbaria, was the son of the infermant Hena Akhter and previously he was Vice-President of Dhaka University Mohsin Hall Chhatra Sangshad as an activist of Jatiotabadi Chhatra Dal and later on he joined Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Due to death of Wali Ashraf, a member of the Parliament from the BNP in the Brahmanbaria- 6 constituency, by election was held in 1995. In that by-election, deceased Shahjahan Howlader Shujan and the accused Dr Roushan Alain, owner of the Libra Pharmaceuticals Ltd, sought nomination from the BNP and the deceased Shujan succeeded in getting nomination from the party. The accused Dr Roushan Alam contested with Shujan in that by election as an independent candidate and the deceased Shujan came out successful by defeating his rival Dr Roushan Alam. Political enmity started in between them from that time. Again, in the National Assembly election of February 1996, the deceased got nomination from the BNP and he was again elected as member of the Parliament from the same constituency. However, in the next general election June, 1996, the BNP gave nomination in favour of the accused Dr Roushan Alam replacing the previous MP Shuian. In the said election of the National Assembly, the accused Dr Roushan Alam could not be elected and he lost to Awami League candidate Captain Taj. As such, he brought allegation against the deceased Shujan making him liable for such defeat in the election. On the basis of such allegation, Shujan was ultimately expelled' from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Due to such political enmity, the accused Dr Roushan Alam and his accomplices namely, accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Humayun Kabir @ Phool Mia, Ziauddin @ Bayes, Ibrahim Noor, Apu Abdul Mannan @ VP Mannan and Giasuddin Jalali started conspiracy to oust him from local politics and they used to threaten Shujan with dire consequences. As such, the victim Shujan had to lodge a GDE in 1996 against terse accused .persons. The victim Shujan was on the run for some time and ultimately, he left this country in the year 1997 and took shelter in Japan out of fear. In the year 2000, he, however, returned to Bangladesh on the eve of National Parliamentary Election which was scheduled to be held in October 2001 and engaged himself in the election activities in the constituency making disclosure to the people that Tarique Zia, son of the then Prime Minister, had given assurance in the matter of giving him nomination from the BNP. At that time, accused Dr Roushan Alam and his followers tried to prevent the victim Shujan from holding his election campaign in the constituency. They filed a false rape' case and managed to issue false warrant of arrest against Shujan for harassment. In spite of taking those steps, the accused persons failed to refrain Shujan and, as such, they hatched conspiracy to kill him. In view of such threat on his life, Shujan had to return to Dhaka on 1-7-2001 taking an alternative route to avoid suspected attack from his political rivals. 

 5. On 3-7-2001 at about 6-00 PM the victim Shahjahan Howlader Shujan went to the residence of his friend PW 3 Nurul Huda Miru located at 73/1 Shantinagar on a casual visit and he stayed there for some time. At about 7-40 PM he left the house of his friend disclosing to the inmates that he was going to meet Tarique Zia on call. Shujan had a companion namely, Shyam Mia (PW 59) who was kept waiting outside in front of Jonaki Cinema Hall, near the house of his friend Miru. When Shujan came in front of Jonaki Cinema Hall and was looking for a transport with the help of Shyam Mia, all on a sudden, two white coloured microbuses approached there and both of them were picked up in one of the vehicles by showing fear of weapon and thereafter left the place. Subsequently, the victim Shujan was stabbed to death by the men of the accused Dr Roushan Alam inside the microbus. Of them, PW 59 Shyam Mia was able to recognise accused Kajal Ahmed Jalili, Humayun Kabir @ Phool Mia, Apu and Bayes. After killing of Shujan inside the microbus his body was shifted to 2nd microbus and PW 59 Shyam Mia was taken to Shyamoli and released with caution of maintaining secrecy; Another miorobus carrying the injured body of Shujan was taken to another destination for in the Press Club area. Subsequently, his dead-body was recovered from the roadside drain, opposite to Bangla Academy Gate. DW 1 Abdul Matin, a rickshaw puller on the street, found-injured body of Shujan lying in the drain and he brought him to the Dhaka Medical College Hospital where the doctor found him already dead at about 8-30 PM. 

 6. On getting information, SI Tota Mia (PW 56) went to Dhaka Medical College Hospital and he found presence of rickshaw puller Abdul Matin there. He visited the place where dead body was found and held inquest on the dead body and sent the unidentified dead body to the morgue for post-mortem examination. Then he lodged first information report on the same night with Ramna Police Station in this connection (PS Case No, 12 dated 3-7-2001), 

 7. On hearing the news that her son was kidnapped in Dhaka and his whereabouts could not be known, PW Hena Akhter, step-mother of the deceased, rushed to Dhaka from the village home and she submitted a written allegation to the Officer-in-Charge of Gulshan Police Station under section 364 of the Penal Code stating names of suspected 5 accused persons namely, Dr Roushan Alam, Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Giasuddin Jalali, Khorshed Alam and Humayun Kabir@ Phool Mia, which was ultimately sent to Motijheel Police Station and it was treated as first information report in this case, On the basis of said first information report Motijheel Police Station Case No,26 dated 7-7-2001 was initiated and on 8-7-2001, the dead body was identified to be of Shujan by his mother and friend PW 8 Deen Mohammad by seeing photograph, wrist watch, key and wearing apparels of the deceased, which were preserved in the Ramna Police Station, Thereafter the dead body was also identified. 

 9. The learned Trial Judge framed charge under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code against the accused (1) Kajal Ahmed Jalali, (2) Khurshed Alam (3) Humayun Kabir @ Phool Mia (4) Abdul Mannan @ VP Mannan, (5) Forkanuddin, (6) Ziauddin @ Bayes, (7) Md Akhter Hossain @ Asker Ali, (8) Kamal, (9) Giasuddin Jalali, (10) Ibrahim Noor Apu (11) Md. Faruque, while separate charges under sections 302/120B/109 of the Penal Code were framed against accused Dr Roushan Alam. Out of them, accused Dr Roushan Alam, Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Khorshed Alam and Humayun Kabir @ Phool Mia were present before the Tribunal at that time and they pleaded not guilty to the charges and claimed to be tried. The remaining accused persons namely Abdul Mannan @ VP Mannan, Ziauddin @ Bayes, Md Akhter Hossain, Kamal, Giasuddin Jalali, Ibrahim Noor Apu and McI Faruque were absent at that time. Subsequently, accused Abdul Mannan @ VP Mannan, Akhter Hossain, Ziauddin @ Bayes and Forkan entered appearance and stood for trial. Again accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Forkan, Akhter Hossain, Ziauddin @ Bayes absconded on getting bail and trial was held in absentia against the absconding accused persons in accordance with law providing State defence lawyer for them. 

 13. PW 1 Hena Akhter is the informant of Motijheel Police Station case dated 7-7-2001 and she is stepmother of the deceased Shujan. According to her testimony, her son Shahjahan Howlader Shujan was elected twice as MP of the Parliament from Banchharampur area and the accused Dr Roushan Alam was a defeated candidate in the by election. Second time Dr Roushan Alam did not contest and Shujan was elected member of the Parliament. Since the election of 1995,political rivalry started in between Shujan and Dr Roushan Alam. She deposed that when her son Shujan used to come to the village home, the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali along with others used to go there and threaten Shujan. She stated that in the year 1996, the accused Dr Roushan Alam contested in the election as candidate of BNP and in that election the victim Shujan did not get nomination from the party. But the accused Dr Roushan Alam could not be elected and he made allegation against the victim Shujan for working against party candidate and Shujan was ultimately expelled from the BNP She testified that Shujan was subjected 10 threat by the said political opponent and subsequently he left this country for Japan where he stayed for about 2/3 years. According to her testimony, on his return from Japan, Shujan came to know that the party would give him nomination and, as such, he used to go to the village home frequently to hold meetings with the local people. She said, in some of those meetings, the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Giasuddin Jalali, Apu, Bayes and others had threatened him. She deposed about such a meeting, which was held-in the house of Kuddus member. At that time, the group of miscreants led by Kajal Ahmed Jalali went there and engaged in an altercation with the men of Shujan. 

 14. This witness appears to have deposed about political rivalry of Shujan with the accused persons on hearing from others. She appears to have deposed about the casual visit of Shujan in the house of Miru on 3-7-2001 and she also stated that he stayed there till 7-00 PM. and then went out of that house by saying that he would be going to meet Tarique Zia and they would go together for hair dressing. But, subsequently, Shujan was found missing after departure from the house of his friend Miru, and on getting the news, she came to Dhaka and lodged first information report under section 364 of the Penal Code, which she proved at the time of giving testimony and it is admitted in evidence as Exhibit-1. It appears that she identified the dead body of Shujan on 8-7-2001 after lodging the first information report. Though she is not supposed to say about the occurrence which had taken place in Dhaka, she appears to have disclosed in the first information report from other sources. From her cross-examination, it appears that she was a member of the Madhyapara Union Parishad at the time of giving testimony, and she said that Kajal Jalali's sister Hosna Jalali was their neighbour at the village Rupashdi. She said that victim Shujan used to reside in Japan. She further said that the facts relating to the occurrence were heard from Deen Mohammad and she could not say about the contents written in the first information report. Even she could not say who actually had written the first information report lodged under her signature. Deen Mohammad, son of her nephew, was present at the time when she signed on the Ejahar, She also heard from Deen Mohammad that the dead body of Shujan was kept in the Dhaka MedicalCollege Hospital. She admitted that she received money of the Insurance Company after the death of Shujan, It is also available from her testimony that Shujan was a close friend of Dulu, the then Minister. It is suggested from the defence side that on 3-7-2001 when Shujan was walking through the road for the purpose of going towards Curzon Hall from TSC four miscreants attacked him, but she denied the suggestion. 

 15. PW 2 Md Younus Mia is another relative of the deceased Shujan and he was also a man of Rupashdi village. He appears to have narrated the common story of political rivalry in between the victim Shujan and Dr Roushan Alam mainly over getting nomination in the election as both of them were members of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party. Corroborating the testimony of PW 1, he also said that the victim Shujan became elected member of the Parliament twice in the years 1995 and 1996. Subsequently, Shujan was expelled from the party due to non-cooperation with the nominated candidate Dr Roushan Alam, and subsequently he went to Japan and stayed there for some years. Thereafter, on his return from Japan in the year 2000, he again started political activities in the local constituency which promoted bitterness with the then candidate of BNP Dr Roushan Alarn. From his evidence. it appears that on 29-6-2001, at night, there was a meeting at the residence of Union Parishad member Kuddus and the accused persons headed by Kajal Ahmed Jalali went there from Dhaka and there was hot exchange of words between the two rival groups. After their departure for Dhaka, the victim Shujan, however, held meetings at Moricha Kandi. He came to know from Abu Taher that the life of Shujan would not be safe on his way back and, as such, he returned to Dhaka in an alternative route on the night following 1-7-2001. This witness also received telephone call about his safe return to Dhaka. But subsequently, on 4-7-2001, he came to know from his son Deen Mohammad and another relative Anwarul Hoque that whereabouts of Shujan could not be known from 3-7-2001. It is also available in his evidence that when the dead body of Shujan was sent. to the village home, the local people ransacked the houses of Kajal Ahmed Jalali and Apu with the conviction, that they had committed murder of Shujan. 

 161 During cross-examination, he deposed that Shujan used to stay either in his (witness) house or in the house of Kuddus Mia, when he used to come to the village home. Shujan never stayed with his stepmother in the viIIage home. He said that 0n 6-11-2001, police recorded his statement for the first time. He also said that Shujan disclosed to him that the accused Dr Roushan Alam was always after him and he might not keep him alive. According to his testimony, the victim once left this country for Japan out of fear. He admitted that he was an accused in the murder case of Amir Hossain bearing Banchha-rampur Police Station Case No. 8 dated 25-1-95. He was also an accused in another Criminal Case which was initiated due to the attack in the house of the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Apu and others. It also transpires from his evidence that the accused Phool Mia was elected as a member of the Union Parishad when he was inside the jail. He said that father of Kajal Ahmed Jalali was a pious man (Peer) in the locality. He categorically admitted that Shyam Mia and his wife Shajeda Begum of village Rupashdi were not known to him. 

 17. PW 3 Md Nurul Huda Miru was Deputy Manager of Rangs Electronics at the relevant time and he used to reside at flat No. B-5 of holding No. 73/1 Shantinagar. He deposed that victim Shujan was his close friend and he came to his residence on 3-7-2001 at about 6/6-30 PM. After his arrival, he disclosed that he was in need of taking rest and came to his residence to sleep for some time and accordingly, he went to the guest room for taking rest. Sometime after, he went to the room of his wife and helped his wife in preparing her lesson. At that time, victim Shujan disclosed that he would go to Tarique Zia and accordingly, at about 7-30 PM, he was getting ready to go outside, and at that time, Foisal Reza and his wife Meri came to his house for the purpose of inviting them on the occasion of birthday of their daughter. At that time, victim Shujan left his house. He also said about disclosure by the victim that Dr Roushan Alam might have killed him by engaging miscreants. Healso stated the name of Kajal Ahmed Jalali. Giasuddin Jalali, Khorshed Alam; Phool Mia and Bayes as members of his "Gunda Bahini". At about 9-00 PM nephewof Shujan namely, Anawarul Huq made telephone can to know whereabouts of his maternal uncle Shujan. Subsequently, on 8-7-2001, the dead body of Shujan and his wearing apparels were found and they were able to identify the dead body. 

 21. PW 6 Abdul Kuddus was a local Union Parishad member at the relevant time. He deposed that the victim Shujan was elected member of the Parliament from their constituency after the death of ex-MP Wali Ashraf. He also deposed about the conflict between Shujan and the, accused Dr Roushan Alam over getting party nomination from their same constituency. He said that Shujan was expelled from the party on the basis of complaint by the defeated candidate of the BNP Dr Roushan Alam in the election held in June, 1996 and he had taken shelter in the house of Helal, owner of the "Standard Lungi" and thereafter he went to Japan. Subsequently, after coming back from Japan in the year 2000, Shujan again started election campaign in his constituency against the desire of his opponent Dr Roushan Alam, It is deposed that when a meeting of Shujan was going on, the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali had driven his Honda inside the gathering and caused disturbance and, as such, there was a commotion in that meeting: On 29-6-2001. Shujan went to the village Rupashdi at last and he disclosed about the threat on his life coming from the accused persons. On that night at about 9/10-00 PM Shujan came to his residence with large number of workers and indoor meeting started with 200/250 people. At that time, they got information that the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Giasuddin Jalali, Phool Mia, Forkan, Faruque, Apu, Bayes, Mannan and Akhter were proceeding towards their meeting with ulterior motive and, as such, they went outside and saw their presence. On that occasion Kajal Ahmed Jalali said, "দেশে তুই বেটা, ঢাকায় আস।” He deposed that Taher gave an information over telephone that the men of Dr Roushan Alam would try to attack him on the way of coming to Dhaka and he should come carefully. On 1-7-2001, Sunday, Shujan left the village for Dhaka via Narsingdi in the afternoon. 

 22. PW 7 Md Kamal Uddin, a shopkeeper of the Rupashdi Bazar, was also present in the meeting on 29-6-2001 which was held in the house of PW 6 Kuddus Member. Narrating similar stories about political rivalry over the competition in getting nomination from the BNP, he deposed that Shujan was under threat after defeat of Dr Roushan Alam mid he went to Chittagong, stayed there for 5/6 months and thereafter left the country for Japan in the year 1997. He also gave testimony about Shujan's return to the country in the month of June. 2000. He testified that on 29-6-2001, there was an indoor meeting of Shujan in the house of Kuddus member and in that meeting they heard that Shujan was going to be nominated by the BNP as he(Shujan) disclosed that Tarique tia had assured hill'! in this respect. Subsequently, at about 9-00/10-00 PM information was received that the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali along with his party men was proceeding towards the house of Kuddus member and, as such, they stopped the meeting and went outside and saw their presence. Witness said "তাদের সাথে আমাদের দেখা হয়। দুই পক্ষ মুখামুখি হয়। আমরা  সংখ্যায় বেশি বিধায় তারা আমাদের পাশ দিয়ে চলে যায় এবং কাজল জালালী পাশ কেটে যাওয়ার পথে বলে যে, দেশে তুমি বেটা। ক্ষমতা থাকলে ঢাকায় আস, তোমাকে আমি দেখে নিব। তারপর তারা চলে যায়।”  He also heard from others that the accused persons had chalked out a plan to attack Shujan on his way back to Dhaka. However, Shujan did not face any difficulty on the way and he received information from his village home that Shujan reached in Dhaka safely. Subsequently, he came to know about the missing news of Shujan. It transpires from his evidence that after the death of Shujan, house of the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali came under attack of the people. This witness suspected that Kajal Ahmed Jalali and other armed cadres of the accused Dr Roushan Alam committed the mischief. He said that the accused Dr Roushan Alam was President of Banchharampur Thana BNP at the relevant time. It is also admitted that in the criminal case initiated for ransacking houses of Jalali, he was an accused. 

 23. PW 8 Deen Muhammad is another relation of the deceased Shujan and he was also a resident of village Rupashdi. He gave testimony about the political activities of deceased Shujan in the locality against the interest of his political opponent accused Dr Roushan Alam, and they had conflict over getting nomination of the BNP from the same constituency. He deposed that on 29-6-2001, the victim Shujan went to several villages Of Banchharampur Police Station to keep contact with the local people. On 29-6-2001, they had a meeting in the house of Kuddus member at about 9-00 PM. At that time, he got information that an armed group headed by Kajal Ahmed Jalali was proceeding towards the house of Kuddus member and, as such, they went outside the house and faced them on the way. At that time, Kajal Ahamed Jalali said তুমি গ্রামে বেটা, ঢাকায় আসলে দেখে নিব” and thereafter they left for Dhaka by the transport of Libra Company. According to his testimony, there was a meeting of the accused persons to formulate a plan of killing the victim and that Akhter Hossain was present there. He said that Akhter Hossain informed the matter to Taher, who communicated the same to victim Shujan about the apprehended attack on him on the way of returning to Dhaka. Accordingly, the victim Shujan had to come to Dhaka in alternative route via Ghorashal. He further deposed that on 3-7-2001, Shujan went to his friend Miru's house at Shantinagar and at about 7-40 PM he went out of his (Miru) house and at that time, he (Shujan) had two mobile phones and one revolver in his possession. This witness got information about missing of Shujan at about 10-00 PM on the same night. He appears to be a seizure list witness in respect of personal diary and other papers of Shujan and proved his signature on it. He said in the cross-examination that Shujan used to reside with his Japanese friend and did not disclose his residing address. He named Shahiduddin Chowdhury Anney, Khairul Kabir Khokan and Amanullah Aman to be close friends of the deceased. 

 24. PW 9 Abed Mia was owner of a telephone shop at village of Rupashdi and he was present at the meeting of Shujan on 29-6-2001. He is also cousin of the victim Shujan. He narrated similar stories to show political rivalry in between the accused persons and Shujan's group as stated by other witnesses. He deposed that 011 30-6-2001, afternoon, Shujan came to his shop in the Bazar and told him that the accused Dr Roushan Alam held a meeting with his men at Dhanmondi Office and he took decision to kill victim Shujan. He also heard from Shujan at that time that one Abu Taher informed the matter to him over telephone. He admitted during cross=examination that he was also accused in 3/4 cases including the case of ransacking house of accused Dr Roushan Alam. It appears that he had no direct knowledge about the conspiracy, but he was present in the meeting of 29- 6-2001 held in the house of Kuddus Member. 

 25. PW 10 Md Foisal Reza was an Advocate by profession, who went to the residence of Nurul Huda Miru at holding No. 73/1, Shantinagar, Dhaka. He testified that on 3-7-2001 at about 7-30 PM he along with his wife Selina Parvin Meri went to the house of Nurul Huda Miru and at that time, they had seen Shahjahan Howlader Shujan in the house. Thereafter, Shahjahan Howlader Shujan left the house in their presence. Subsequently, he came to know from newspapers that Shahjahan Howlader Shujan was killed. 

 27. PW 11 Selina Parvin Meri gave testimony about seeing the victim Shujan in the house of Nurul Huda Miru as stated by her husband PW 10. 

 31. PW 14 Md Abu Taher was a co-villager of the victim and he deposed that on 30-6-2001 at about 10-00/11-00 AM Akhter Hossain made a telephone call asking  him whether Shujan had already left for Dhaka or not. Thereafter, he asked him to inform Shujan that there was apprehension of an attack on his life on the way of his return to Dhaka, so he should not come on that day. Thereafter, he informed the matter to Abed Mia of Rupashdi Bazar and the matter was informed to Shujan. Subsequently, Shujan returned to Dhaka at about 10-00 PM via Narsingdi-Gorashal Road. This witness deposed that he heard from others that on 29-6-2001 there was a hot exchange of words in between the victim and the accused persons. His statement appears to have been recorded by the Magistrate under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure on 19-1-2003. 

 32. PW 15 Hafez Rafiqul Islam had business in Dhaka at the relevant time and he used to accompany Shahjahan Howlader Shujan when he used to go to his village. He was also an activist of BNP at the relevant time. After the occurrence, he came to know from Miru that whereabouts of Shujan could not be ascertained for two days. He also gave testimony about the political enmity in between Kajal Ahmed Jalali and Shujan. He deposed that on one occasion, Kajal Ahmed Jalali asked as to why he (PW 15) was keeping touch with bogus leader like Shujan. He admitted that Kajal Ahmed Jalali was a Central leader of BNP Chhatra Dal at the relevant time. 

 44. PW 26 Alhaj Mohammad Helaluddin was owner of "Standard Lungi" and he testified that in the year 1996, Shujan came to him and disclosed that he was not safe in Dhaka and, as such, this witness had sent him to his nephew Commander Abul Hasnat @ Lintu at Chittagong. He said that subsequently Shujan went to Japan and stayed there for some time and subsequently returned to Bangladesh. He gave testimony that before 2 days of his missing news, the victim Shujan informed him over telephone that a telephonic message was received from Abed Mia's Fax-Phone shop asking him (Shujan) not to undertake journey for Dhaka. Subsequently, he got his death news and attended his 'Janaja.' 

 47. PW 28 Constable Delwer Hossain appears to have carried the dead body of the victim to the Dhaka Medical College Hospital morgue for post-mortem examination. He deposed that on 3-7-2001 at about 23-05 hours, he went with Sf Tota Mia of Ramna Police Station and he was present at the time of preparing inquest report by him. The blood stained genzi and other belongings of the deceased, found with the dead body, were seized in his presence and he identified those materials. 

 49. PW 29 Edan Mir was a co-villager, who testified about creating disturbance in the meeting of Shujan by the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, who went there on a Honda. He also deposed that on another occasion Kajal Ahmed Jalali threatened Shujan by saying,  "তুই ঢাকায় আয়, দেশে তুই বেটা, ঢাকায় এলে ২/৩ দিন পরে মজা বুঝবি।” He appears to be an illiterate person having no idea about the date and time. However, he was present along with 100/150 people who gathered there in support of Shujan. He deposed that about 517 months after the occurrence of murder, he made statement before the investigating officer. 

 55. PW 34 Dewan Samir was a businessman having friendship with the deceased Shujan. He testified that deceased Shujan was a student leader in the University and subsequently he was elected MP from the local constituency. This witness also lived in Japan for about 10 years and returned to this country in the year 1995 and he established Sakura Textile Mill at Pachdona, Narshingdi. Deceased Shujan informed him that he would get nomination from the BNP. He used to accompany Tarique Zia in different programmes in Bogra. He got information from Anowar, a relative of Shujan, that the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, VP Mannan, Phool Mia and Dr Roushan Alam went to the village Rupashdi by a microbus. On that occasion, Shujan had altercation with the accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, and thereafter the accused persons came back to Dhaka. After 2/3 days, he got missing news of Shujan through Anowar. But no other witness has named Dr Roushan Alam to be a person present on that occasion. 

 59. PW 37 Md. Hakim was a driver and he was present in the Dhaka Medical College Hospital morgue when the police prepared inquest report on an unidentified dead body. He proved his signature in the inquest report. Subsequently he came to know that it was the dead body of Ex-MP Shahjahan Howlader Shujan. 

 62. PW 40 Md Sekander Ali was a Constable in Ramna Police Station at the relevant time. He deposed that on 3-7-2001, he went to Dhaka Medical College Hospital at about 23-35 hours and Sub-Inspector Tota Mia prepared seizure list in his presence where he put his signature. The witness also identified the material Exhibits which were found with the dead body of Shujan. 

 65. PW 43 Abdul Awal was Chemical Examiner, CID, Dhaka, at the relevant time. He deposed that on 29-5-2002, he received a packet from ASI Nurul Islam in connection with Ramna Police Station Case No. 12 dated 3-7-2001. After examination of the materials contained in the packet, he ascertained existence of blood in those dust substance. Accordingly, he submitted Chemical Examination Report dated 20-6-2002, which was admitted in evidence as Exhibit-22.

 144. In this case, accused Dr RoushanAlam has been convicted under sections 302/120B of the Penal Code. Question has been raised as to whether there was any ingredient of criminal conspiracy in the evidence available on the record against the accused. Criminal conspiracy as defined in section 120A of the Penal Code is an agreement between two or more persons to commit a criminal offence. So, prosecution is to prove by preponderance of evidence that there was a meeting of minds amongst the accused persons having common programme to work together in furtherance of such common design. It is some sort of integrated united effort to achieve the common offensive purpose. In this case, the prosecution has brought specific allegation about holding such a meeting against accused persons at KDH Laboratory, Dhanmondi, Dhaka held on 30-6-2001, where the accused Dr Roushan Alam asked his men namely, accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Phool Mia, VP Mannan, Apu, Faruque and others to chase Shujan on his way of returning to Dhaka from the village Rupashdi and kill him on the way. PW 60 Akhtar Hossain appears to be a direct witness to the meeting and he leaked out the secret matter and informed PW 14 Abu Taher, who, in turn, sent message to Shujan through the telephone of PW 9 Abed Mia. However, no such attack was made on his return journey to Dhaka on that occasion and that victim Shujan had returned to Dhaka on 1-7-2001 at about 10-00 PM safely. There is no evidence to show any other conspiracy meeting. Moreover, hearsay evidence of PWs 2, 8, 9, 13 and others cannot be acceptable without the evidence of eye-witness himself (PW 60). Even if it is believed that Dr Roushan Alam gave direction to other accused persons to kill Shujan, there is hardly any room to make out a case of criminal conspiracy, which falls short of consensus of all persons present there about the killing. Moreover, accused Dr Roushan Alam cannot alone be held liable for criminal conspiracy which requires agreement by two or more persons. In this case, other participants in the meeting were convicted under sections 302/34 and not under sections 3021-120B of the Penal Code. PW 60 Akhter Hossain is the only witness to prove holding of such meeting of conspiracy and he told others about such conspiracy meeting. But this witness did not say in his evidence that the accused Dr Roushan Alam was present in the said meeting held on 30-6-2001 at KDH Dhanmondi. This witness was Personal Assistant (PA) of Shujan and it was very unlikely that he would be allowed to remain inside while meeting was going on. However, he deposed that on 30-6-2001, he went to KDH of Dr Roushan Alam and saw accused Kajal Ahmed Jalali, Apu, Faruque, Bayes and Phool Mia. Neither he saw Dr Roushan Alam nor he said about any talk of conspiracy in the meeting. He also did not say date, time and subject matters of the meeting, His 164 statement (Exhibit-25) also does not disclose presence of Dr Roushan Alam in the meeting. There is no other witness of the prosecution who was present in the meeting of conspiracy at the KDH on 30-6-2001. So, charge of criminal conspiracy against Dr Roushan Alam has no foundation to stand on. His complicity with the actual occurrence of murder is hardly available anywhere. His participation in any other incidental acts with other accused persons at village Ruposhdi also remains unfounded.

 146. In arriving at a finding under the headline "Conspiracy made on 30-6-2001 at KDH Laboratory belonging to Dr Roushan Alam," the learned Tribunal Judge appears to have used 164 statement of PW 60 Akhter Hossain reproducing the same in the judgment and he appears to have considered the same as a piece of evidence. This appears to be a gross illegality. Such statement of a witness was recorded by the Magistrate behind the back of the accused persons and it can never be used as substantive evidence against them in any way. It may be mentioned here that the object of recording 164 statement of the prosecution witness, during investigation, is to obtain a hold over so that he cannot usually deviate from what he said earlier. Such statement can only be used by the accused for the purpose of cross-examining him to impeach his credibility. It may be used only to corroborate or contradict a statement made by him before the Court in the manner provided under sections 145 and 155(3) of the Evidence Act. Moreover, 164 statement of PW 60 Akter Hossain appears to have been recorded by the Magistrate on 8-2-2003 i.e. after more than 1-1/2 years from the date of occurrence. Therefore, such a belated statement is also unworthy of credit. This is a well settled principle by several case decisions in our jurisdiction.

In this case as many as 7 Magistrates were examined by the prosecution, most of whom came to prove 164 statements of 7 witnesses, out of which, many witnesses were not even examined in the Court. Therefore, we do not find any justification in making such prior statements of the absent witnesses Exhibits. Moreover, 164 statement of the witnesses are not by itself admissible in evidence for consideration as has been done in this case.

In support of the said testimony, the connected police forwarding dated on 7-10-2002 is also available with the LCRs where specific dates with duration of such conversations from each mobile set have been mentioned. These are examples of perfunctory nature of investigation casting serious doubt in the prosecution case. 

 151. However, those local witnesses have given testimony mainly against Kajal Ahmed Jalali and others who were seen in the village to create obstruction in the processions and meetings of Shujan. On 29-6-2001, when a meeting of Shujan was going on in the house of PW 6 Kuddus member at 9-00 PM, Kajal Ahmed Jalali and his cadre group came to the village reportedly for attacking them. So, Shujan's  partymen went out and advanced towards them and Kajal Ahmed Jalali group retreated after exchange of words. On that occasion Kajal Ahmed Jalali said "দেশে তুই বেটা, ঢাকা আয় দেখা, যাবে।” Most of the local witnesses reproduced his utterance in different languages. However, such type of utterance was not very unusual when agitation starts in between the two groups of people opposing each other in the political field. For that reason, it cannot be deduced that the said utterance had any direct bearing on the subsequent acts of murder, which took place in Dhaka, particularly when there is no other evidence to link up the accused persons with the actual act committing murder. Even if it is considered that the victim was under threat on his life for carrying out election campaign against common political interest of the accused persons and the accused persons had grudge due to such political rivalry, does it prove anything more than the rivalry or enmity between the two parties? The answer is obviously in the negative. There must have to be some nexus of the political rivalry and threat with the murder. In the absence of any other evidence to link up circumstances to show prior enmity with the occurrence of murder, it is very risky to jump to the conclusive finding against those accused persons and such finding must not fulfil the requirement of law in adjudication. Enmity is a double-edged weapon, and possibility of using such weapon on suspicion against the persons inimical to the deceased, cannot also be ruled out. 

 154. During cross-examination, the prosecution could not impeach credibility of this important witness with reference to his 161 statement. Admittedly, he picked up the injured person from the road-side drain and carried him to the hospital by his rickshaw. Moreover, there are some probable suggestions to give rise to some other hypotheses as well. 

 157. In this respect, we have seen that large number of people of village Rupashdi were examined by the prosecution, but some material and probable witnesses of the surrounding areas where from Shujan was allegedly kidnapped and his body was recovered, were not examined. DW 1 Abdul Matin deposed that many people gathered when he found an injured man lying on the roadside drain, opposite to Bangla Academy but none of them were examined by investigating officer except CS witness No.5 Md. Shaheen, but he has not been examined at the time of trial. Cited witness PW 32 Zakir Hossain, who talked with the deceased last at about 8-00 PM on the very night of occurrence and who used to reside with the victim Shujan in a mess, was also left out. Again, cited witness Sajeda, wife of eye-witness PW 59, was an important person to testify veracity of the sole eye-witness about his long unusual stay at Dinajpur after the occurrence, but she was also withheld. Amjad Hossain Ostad was a constant companion of deceased, but he was not examined. Amongst the most important left-out persons are Badal Mia and Alam Khan, who had talks with the persons holding possession of the stolen Mobile Phones belonging to the deceased. If they were examined, it would have been possible to know identity of the real assailants. They were not brought in the picture even after arrest. Even we do not find explanation as to why they were not examined and investigation was not proceeded further in that direction. In such view of the matter, we find substance in the submissions of the learned Advocates for the accused persons that the accused persons are entitled to get benefit of adverse presumption under section 1 14(g) of the Evidence Act for non-examination of some material witnesses. In this respect, the case of State vs Fazal and others, reported in 39 DLR (AD) 166 and Anaddi @ Ayenuddin and others vs State reported in 6 BLC 310 may be referred to.
